observations: Photo 0: one gold-coloured slim game console held in a hand, with the PlayStation 'PS' logo on the top and a small PS logo on the front corner.
Photo 0: the thin body with rounded edges and the front slot and buttons match the PS4 Slim shape.
Photo 0: a second gold console and stacks of black consoles are in the background, and a shop watermark crosses the image, so this is a dealer shelf.
Photo 0: top and front look clean with no visible scratches; the back, ports, bottom label and storage size are not shown.
Photo 0: no controller, cables or other accessories appear, and the console is not shown switched on.

read_from: photo 0 PS logo on top and front
photo 0 slim body shape and gold finish

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean top and front with no visible scratches; the back and bottom are not shown.
Photo 0 shows the PS logo and the PS4 Slim body shape.
Photo 0 shows a gold finish rather than the standard black; which edition and storage size is not shown on a label.

claims.claim: Other accessories, it comes with... (text cut off)

risks.risk: Console does not boot, or has a faulty HDMI port, disc drive or hard drive.
risks.proof: A clip switching the console on to the home screen on a TV, inserting a disc, and opening Settings > System > System Information.

risks.risk: Controller missing, faulty or a non-original copy.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller beside the console, then a clip of it pairing and moving through the menu.

risks.risk: Storage size unknown; it may be the smaller drive.
risks.proof: A photo of the bottom label or the System Information screen showing capacity.

risks.risk: The pictured unit is a shop display, not the one that will be delivered.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual unit's bottom label serial next to a handwritten note with today's date.

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting to the home screen and showing System Information with storage size.
Photo of the bottom serial label beside a dated handwritten note.
Photo of the controller and all accessories, and a clip of the controller in use.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a gold PS4 Slim with the PlayStation logo, so it can be priced at its worst case as the smaller-storage console alone, not working and without a controller. A boot clip, storage screen and controller proof would raise it.
